data.current_description: Same contract as `GET /api/v1/search`, but accepts parameters as a JSON body. Preferred for location-bearing requests because GET-style location encoding is awkward and keeps `latitude`/`longitude` out of HTTP access logs. data.description_suggestion: Performs a web search with parameters provided as a JSON request body. Functionally identical to GET /api/v1/search but preferred for location-bearing requests, as it avoids awkward GET-style location encoding and keeps sensitive coordinates out of HTTP access logs. Accepts all GET query parameters as body fields, plus optional location fields (latitude, longitude, accuracy, city, state, countryCode, postalCode, timezone, location). Returns structured search results with configurable search effort (searchMode), domain/date filtering, query operators, and multiple output formats (JSON or LLM-ready markdown via format=context).
